channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Google launches Guided Learning in Classroom worldwide, pilots it in Search — and turns school AI off by default
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google announced on November 3, 2026 that Guided Learning is now globally available in Google Classroom, with a Search pilot starting in select U.S. schools later this month — and that Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom and Google Search will be off for K-12 student accounts until administrators turn them on.

item.title: Straive and Anthropic partner to deploy enterprise AI responsibly, with governance and human oversight
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Straive announced a partnership with Anthropic on November 3, 2026, pairing Anthropic’s AI models with Straive’s governance, domain expertise and human oversight to help enterprises build, deploy and run AI in industry-specific workflows.

item.title: Fal raises $1.3 billion at a $16 billion valuation as inference demand outruns its capacity
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Fal announced its Series E and Series F together on November 3, 2026: $1.65 billion combined, with the $1.3 billion Bessemer-led Series F valuing the AI inference startup at $16 billion — double its April valuation — after demand forced it to rate-limit customers over the summer, Bloomberg reported.

item.title: Ortelan launches Praus, a sovereign AI harness that routes each question to the right open model — and checks the answer
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Ortelan Labs launched Praus on November 3, 2026, a harness that runs open-source models on its own on-premises infrastructure, picks the best-suited model for each request and checks the result before returning it. In the company's own testing it ranked first on two of nine public benchmarks; Ortelan says those figures are self-reported and not independently verified.

item.title: Endeavor 1.1: Flower Labs adds EU inference and image inputs, claiming the top composite score over OpenAI and Anthropic
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Flower Labs introduced Endeavor 1.1 on November 3, 2026, adding image inputs and inference on GPUs in the European Union, with private-cloud and on-premises deployment. Flower says its equal-weight composite of four benchmarks puts Endeavor 1.1 ahead of GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Fable 5 — a vendor-built comparison that still needs independent testing.

item.title: PagerDuty launches Paige, an SRE agent to triage and fix incidents alongside humans — and learn from each one
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: PagerDuty announced Paige on November 3, 2026, a site reliability engineering agent on the renamed PD Reliability Platform that detects, investigates and remediates incidents with human teams, running with a human in the loop or autonomously on well-understood incidents. The platform and Paige are generally available the same day, alongside a new PD Labs innovation centre.

item.title: See every coding agent at once: hands-on with whatsmyagentdoing's live office
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: whatsmyagentdoing (Charonyuu/whatsmyagentdoing, MIT, 371 GitHub stars) turns the session logs Claude Code, Codex and nine more coding agents already write into a live office in your browser: figures at desks while they work, wandering off duty when they finish, and waving when they need you. This guide installs it with one clone, tries the made-up demo team first, reads real sessions, and uses its JSON snapshot, privacy mode and stuck-agent alerts, with the log-format limits the project states itself.

item.title: Atsign launches EdgeAI to connect edge AI systems without exposing them — Intel hardware handles the encryption
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Atsign announced EdgeAI on November 3, 2026, a packaged zero-trust solution that connects distributed edge AI, physical AI and IoT systems across networks without exposing them publicly, with an identity-based kill switch and Intel hardware-backed encryption Atsign says reaches up to 88 times the throughput of software-only encryption.

item.title: China to regulate AI from data to deployment: NDRC fast-tracks a full-lifecycle law covering DeepSeek, Alibaba and Moonshot
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: China’s National Development and Reform Commission said on November 3, 2026 it will accelerate comprehensive AI legislation covering the full lifecycle of AI — data, computing power and algorithms — with safety standards, incident disclosure and regulatory sandboxes, in a regime expected to cover DeepSeek, Moonshot and Alibaba.

item.title: UK cyber chief warns AI malware is “highly likely” in a ransomware attack on critical infrastructure by 2028
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The NCSC’s Annual Review 2026, published November 3, 2026, judges AI-powered malware “highly likely” to feature in a ransomware attack on UK critical national infrastructure by 2028 — not through new kinds of attack, but by finding old flaws faster.

item.title: Baidu launches Apollo World, a world model that simulates 100,000 km of robotaxi driving a day
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Unveiled at Baidu AI Day in Shenzhen on November 3, 2026, Apollo World is an agent-driven multimodal world model that generates real-time camera and lidar streams for training Apollo Go’s robotaxis, drawing on more than 350 million kilometres of real-world driving.

item.title: Enterprise AI spending hit $176.8 billion in 2026, up 5.4x — agents now generate 80% of model tokens
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Menlo Ventures’ 2026 State of Enterprise AI report, released November 3, 2026, puts enterprise AI spending at $176.8 billion, up from $33 billion in 2025, and finds agents generate 80% of tokens on OpenRouter — with Anthropic, OpenAI and Google capturing 69% of deployment spending.

item.title: CrowdStrike adds an AI Kill Switch to Falcon Guardian: stop a rogue agent at the Gateway, block its return
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: CrowdStrike announced an AI Kill Switch for Falcon Guardian on November 3, 2026, letting an authorized administrator terminate a misbehaving agent, block it from launching again and cut off its enterprise network access — starting at the Gateway, with termination on the endpoint still to come.

item.title: See how your app actually fits together: hands-on with Floorplan
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Floorplan (haydenschmitty/floorplan, MIT, 2,376 GitHub stars) is a Claude Code and Codex plugin that has Claude or Codex read your codebase and draw an interactive, plain-English map of its parts, files, endpoints, screens and outside services, with a health check and a record of recent work. This guide installs it, makes a first map, questions the map, updates it after a change, and exports it, with the local-only limits the project states itself.

item.title: Drax, Brookfield and Radiant target a 1GW AI data centre at Drax Power Station — £20bn-plus if built in full
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Drax Group, Brookfield and Radiant signed an agreement on November 3, 2026 to develop an AI data centre of more than 1GW at Drax Power Station in North Yorkshire, with Brookfield estimating total potential investment above £20 billion including chips — but the first 100MW phase still needs planning approval, a tenant and final investment decisions.

item.title: NVIDIA brings physical and agentic AI to cities: 150+ resident-service deployments in Spain, 17,000 cameras in Malaysia
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NVIDIA said on November 3, 2026 that it and its partners are expanding physical AI and AI agents to cities worldwide, from resident-service agents in Spain to vision agents scaling toward 17,000 cameras in Malaysia — with shared infrastructure and digital twins tying the projects together.

item.title: AGIBOT unveils GO-3 Preview: a robot model that tops three benchmarks — and keeps learning on the job
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AGIBOT unveiled GO-3 Preview on November 3, 2026, an embodied foundation model it says ranks first on RoboDojo, RoboTwin and RoboColiseum. The model will be fully open-sourced by the end of 2026.

item.title: Granter raises €1.6M to take its AI grant-writing assistant across Europe
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Granter has raised €1.6 million, led by 3XP Global, to expand its AI-powered platform that helps businesses identify, apply for, and manage European public funding — work the company says can fall from weeks to under an hour.

item.title: 2CRSi lands a €60M+ order for 83 NVIDIA B300 servers from Exaion — sovereign inference, delivered by December
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: 2CRSi announced on November 3, 2026, a binding order worth more than €60 million from Exaion for 83 NVIDIA HGX B300 AI servers, plus storage and maintenance, with all 83 to be delivered by the end of December 2026 as Exaion expands from model training into private on-premises inference.

item.title: One tiny binary, any model, plain English: hands-on with Shim
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Shim (Balanov/shim, MIT, 383 GitHub stars) is a 7.29 MiB static Go binary that wires any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic model API, MCP servers and Agent Skills into one terminal harness with no daemon, no TUI and no telemetry. This guide installs v0.1.0, runs shim setup, adds a local model and a hosted model, tests both, runs a read-only agent task, connects an MCP server, installs a skill, sets up the local-model command router and permissions, and resumes a session, with the safety limits the project states itself.

item.title: PATEO puts Doubao and Nemotron in the car: an AI Box on NVIDIA Thor that runs without the cloud
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: PATEO announced on November 3, 2026, an AI Box built on NVIDIA DRIVE AGX Thor that runs ByteDance's 35-billion-parameter Doubao model and NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 speech recognition locally in the vehicle, with a project nomination pointing to mass production in the second quarter of 2027.

item.title: Cohere launches Defence AI Accelerator in Singapore to move sovereign AI from pilots to operations
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cohere announced on November 3, 2026, a Defence AI Accelerator in Singapore to help defence organizations and other sovereign customers move AI applications from proof-of-concept to operational deployment in highly secure environments, using its models and its North agentic AI platform.

item.title: xAI's Data Bot is Grok Bot's shared data scientist — and it handled 70 hours of work in a week
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: xAI introduced Data Bot on November 2, 2026, a Team Bot in Grok Bot that queries SpaceXSI's data warehouse using skills and shared memory maintained by its data science team. The company estimates it handled about 70 hours of work in the week before publication.

item.title: Marvell to buy Lumentum for $115 billion, betting AI data centers move from copper to light
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Marvell announced a definitive agreement on November 2, 2026, to acquire Lumentum in an all-stock deal with an implied enterprise value of $115 billion. Lumentum stockholders would receive 4.500 Marvell shares per share — about $1,132, a 23.9% premium to October 28 — and own about 33% of the combined company, which the companies expect to close in the first half of 2028.

item.title: ECARX and Arm sign MoU to explore high-performance AI computing for vehicles and physical AI
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: ECARX and Arm signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding on November 2, 2026, to jointly explore next-generation high-performance AI computing platforms for mobility and cross-industry physical-AI applications, building on SiEngine chip work that has produced millions of 7nm SE1000 units since March 2023. No chip, financial terms or timetable were announced.
